reports.title: Password reset confirm does not reject an already-used reset token
reports.summary: Confirming a password reset with a token that was already used did not return 400 token_used. This likely lets anyone holding an old reset link change the password again; the cause is unconfirmed (possibly a regression of BUG-1042).
reports.severity_rationale: Reusable reset links allow account takeover, a security impact on a core flow.
reports.priority_rationale: Security issue in a live flow; fix in the next release after confirming the cause.
